ShortDescription.Value: Better transit boarding. Skip late passengers who are too far away and can make transit vehicles stuck longer. Cims can run sooner to catch their transit.

Publish.LongDescription:
#### Late Passengers stop holding up transit
* Like Japanese oshiya 👨‍✈️ pushers, but in a mod 😊
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
The game can keep transit stuck waiting long past departure time — even when the cim is far away!
Vanilla only releases a stuck transit vehicle after ~10 in-game minutes.
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
**Better Boarding steps in much sooner to skip late passengers who are too far away so they don't hold everyone up. Transit can keep moving sooner.** In testing, before-and-after comparisons also showed higher total transit usage.
### 🏃‍➡️🏃‍♀️‍➡️🏃‍♂️‍➡️ 🚍 More Transit Use
* ✅ **Skip Late Passengers** — after a short grace, a late passenger who is too far away from the stop/station and vehicle can miss it instead of holding it up (bus, tram, train, or subway). Groups/families are handled too. * ✅ **Cims Run Sooner** — assigned passengers start running before vanilla normally tells them to. * ✅ **Helps long train platforms** — cims hanging around far from the doors get a head start instead of waiting until departure time to start running (vanilla behavior). * ✅ **Boarding/Loading** — adjust from **1x vanilla to 5x**, for shorter planned dwell/loading times. * Vanilla may still **hold a vehicle briefly for spacing** as part of its un-bunching system. * Skipped cims aren't deleted; vanilla can continue or reroute their trip.
Reduce boarding delays, traffic backups, and vehicles bunching up — especially in busy transit cities.
### Important
* **Compatibility:** don't use Better Boarding and All Aboard together — pick one. * Some players report no issues using Smart Transportation with Better Boarding. * Works nicely with [All Transit + Trucks](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/138390/Windows). * Safe to remove anytime. No Harmony patches and no replacement of the game's transport systems. * This doesn't fix severe traffic or poor road design that causes transit vehicle backups. This is a helper, not a miracle :)
### Support and feedback
* Easiest way to support is click the LIKE 👍 button (top right). No donations requested. * Feedback and PRs welcome through the GitHub and Discord links (icons on the right).
### How does it work?
Better Boarding mainly fixes citizen behavior that can keep boarding open too long.
**Late passengers / families**
* Riders confirmed far from the bus/tram stop or train/subway station get a short grace after scheduled departure time, then can miss that vehicle instead of holding everyone. Vanilla naturally reassigns them, often to the next vehicle. * Families/groups are kept together where possible. If a group leader is already aboard, a separated child or pet is handled so one straggler doesn't hold up transit.
**Cims Run Sooner**
* Vanilla normally waits until departure time before telling an assigned cim to run. * Better Boarding can start them running up to 512 simulation frames earlier (about 2.8 in-game minutes), especially useful on long platforms. * Works with buses, trains, trams, subways.
**Boarding / Loading speed**
* Changes stop/loading time. * 1x = vanilla, 3x = recommended, 5x = shortest dwell. * This is separate from Skip Late and Run Sooner. * This mod does not change departure times. That is left to vanilla as it has a robust system in place for scheduling and un-bunching and just needs a little help. Goal is not to replace vanilla systems. This is a lightweight system working with the game methods to help reduce hiccups.
### Bonus Status report
Check Options after your city runs for a bit to see waiting passengers, worst stops, late passengers skipped, and Run Sooner counts.
**Stats to Log** creates a detailed one-time report with stop names, Entity IDs, line hints, and more. It only runs when clicked.
### Credits and Thanks
* River-Mochi — mod author * bcallender's All Aboard and Wayze's InstantBoarding — inspiration * yenyang (Anarchy) — code review, feedback, and testing * 🎀 foxxy ✿, MayorCheeks, Empiiey, Neco1996, Gagaxm — testing * Sunny Scunny - extra testing and feedback * elGendo87 — Spanish editor, thumbnail straightener, testing * Thumbnail edited photo: [Philadelphia train flap board](https://www.inquirer.com/philly/news/20160828_Sign_of_the_times__At_30th_Street_Station__display_board_will_soon_be_no_more.html)
### 15+ Languages
English, Français, Deutsch, Español, Italiano, Polski, Português (Brasil), Português (Portugal), Türkçe, ไทย Thai, Tiếng Việt, Українська, 日本語, 한국어, 简体中文, 繁體中文
#### What does lightweight mean?
Better Boarding works alongside the game's normal transport systems instead of replacing whole system files. It is designed for low performance impact, even in large cities.
If you got this far, congrats 😄 There is a senryu poem I wrote just for you in the images.
